title: Canadian Cosmetic Cluster launches awards focused on industry opportunities
summary: The Canadian Cosmetic Cluster has launched the inaugural Canadian Cosmetic Cluster Awards, an international program designed to recognize innovation across the beauty industry while providing winners with practical support to accelerate their development. Conceived and developed by Margarita Sidorova, Founder and President of the Canadian Cosmetic Cluster, alongside Mary Orlando and Frank Turco, the awards aim to go beyond traditional recognition. Winners will gain access to mentoring,... - Industry buzz
